rubrics: The response should only include parks that are above 1,500 square kilometers: Serengeti National Park (30,000 sq km), Addo Elephant National Park (1,600 sq km), Bandhavgarh National Park (1,536 sq km), and Masai Mara National Park (1,510 sq km).
The response should only include parks that have wild cats: Bandhavgarh National Park, Serengeti National Park, Addo Elephant National Park, and Masai Mara National Park.

The response should list the species of wildcats found in each park: Bandhavgarh National Park: tiger, leopard, and caracal. Serengeti National Park: lion, leopard, cheetah. Addo Elephant National Park: lion. Masai Mara National Park: lion, leopard, cheetah.
The response should not include any animal species outside of wildcats: tiger, leopard, caracal, cheetah and lion. For example, the response should not mention striped hyena when listing animals.
The response should include the continent names in all caps. For example, ASIA and AFRICA.

The response should list the national parks in asian countries (Bandhavgarh National Park) first, then listing the parks in African countries (Serengeti National Park, Addo Elephant National Park, Masai Mara National Park). For example, the response should not mention Masai Mara National park before Bandhavgarh National Park.
Within the ASIAN parks section, the response should list only Bandhavgarh National Park (1,536 sq km) as it is the only Asian park meeting both criteria (above 1,500 sq km and has wild cats).

Within the AFRICAN parks section, the response should list parks in this order from largest to smallest: Serengeti National Park (30,000 sq km), Addo Elephant National Park (1,600 sq km), Masai Mara National Park (1,510 sq km).
The response should bold the names of wild cat species mentioned. For example, lion, leopard, cheetah, tiger, and caracal.
The response should not use bold on anything aside from the names of wild cats.

The response should include at least two emojis that are themed around the wildlife, safari, travel, or animals . For example, animal-related emojis such as 🦁 or 🐯 would be appropriate in the wildlife/safari context.
The response should use a maximum of three exclamation points in each response.
The response should use numbered lists (not bullet points) when listing four or more items.
The response should use bullet points (not numbers) for lists of three or less items.
The response should end with a follow-up question that encourages the user to continue the conversation. For example, "What kind of safari experience are you dreaming of?"
